sky-princess.title: Muster drill: go to your station
sky-princess.detail: The safety drill every guest attends before sailing: learn your muster station and how to use your life jacket. Go to your station as soon as the signal sounds.

sky-princess.title: Sail-away party
sky-princess.detail: Celebrate leaving port with music, drinks and the cruise staff, on deck as the ship pulls away.

sky-princess.title: Welcome music in the Piazza
sky-princess.detail: Live music in the atrium to welcome you aboard. Grab a drink and settle in for the first evening.

sky-princess.title: Welcome aboard show
sky-princess.detail: Meet the ship’s entertainers in a short variety show on the first night of the cruise.

sky-princess.title: Kids’ club open house
sky-princess.detail: Kids see the club, meet the youth staff and try a few games. Parents are welcome to look around.

sky-princess.title: Teen lounge meet-up
sky-princess.detail: Teens meet each other and the staff at their own lounge, with music and games to break the ice.

sky-princess.title: Morning stretch
sky-princess.detail: A gentle morning stretch to start the day. No experience needed, and the class is open to everyone.

sky-princess.title: Team trivia
sky-princess.detail: Teams compete for bragging rights in the ship’s trivia. No experience needed, just a team and a sense of humour.

sky-princess.title: Cooking demo with the executive chef
sky-princess.detail: The executive chef shows how a favourite dish is made and shares a few kitchen secrets, with tastes to follow.

sky-princess.title: Bingo
sky-princess.detail: Mark your numbers and shout when you win. Cards are on sale at the door and there are prizes for the lucky.

sky-princess.title: Art talk: the ship’s collection
sky-princess.detail: A short talk about the art hanging around the ship, who made it and what to look for as you walk past it.

sky-princess.title: Craft time
sky-princess.detail: A relaxed craft hour for children, with supplies on the table. They make something to take home.

sky-princess.title: Tween games afternoon
sky-princess.detail: Games and challenges for the 8 to 12s, run by the youth staff in their own space.

sky-princess.title: Teen dance night
sky-princess.detail: A dance night for teens, with a DJ, lights and the lounge to themselves.

sky-princess.title: Spa tour and tasting
sky-princess.detail: See the treatment rooms and the thermal suite, and try a taste of what the spa serves.

sky-princess.title: Main stage production
sky-princess.detail: The ship’s cast and band perform a full production on the main stage, with singers, dancers and lights.

sky-princess.title: Main stage production, early show
sky-princess.detail: The first showing of the main stage production, an early start before dinner.

sky-princess.title: Live jazz
sky-princess.detail: Live jazz in the lounge, played for listening and for a slow dance.

sky-princess.title: Piazza live band
sky-princess.detail: A live band plays in the atrium while the evening gets going. Come for a song or stay for the set.

sky-princess.title: Aerial show on the SeaWalk
sky-princess.detail: Aerialists and acrobats perform above the SeaWalk, with the sea beneath and the night sky above. A show for the whole family.

sky-princess.title: Dance party at the Sea View Bar
sky-princess.detail: A DJ plays dance music in the Sea View Bar, a late-night party for adults.

sky-princess.title: Movie under the stars
sky-princess.detail: A film on the big outdoor screen, with a deck chair and popcorn. Bring a blanket if the evening is cool.

sky-princess.title: Wine tasting
sky-princess.detail: A guided tasting of wines from around the world, led by the sommelier. Places are limited.

sky-princess.title: Farewell show
sky-princess.detail: The cast and the band say goodbye with a show of favourites from the week.

sky-princess.title: Disembarkation talk
sky-princess.detail: How luggage, departure groups and customs work on the last morning, so you can leave without a fuss.

sky-princess.title: Tomorrow’s port: talk and questions
sky-princess.detail: The shore team previews the next port: maps, tips and answers to your questions before you go ashore.

sky-princess.title: Sail-away steel drums
sky-princess.detail: Steel drums and tropical music on deck as the ship sails away from port.

sky-princess.title: Main stage production
sky-princess.detail: The ship’s cast and band perform a full production on the main stage, with singers, dancers and lights.

sky-princess.title: Evening kids’ club
sky-princess.detail: An evening of games and crafts for children while the ship is in port, run by the youth staff.

sky-princess.title: Quiet hour in the spa
sky-princess.detail: A calm hour in the spa while most guests are ashore, with the thermal suite and quiet rooms to yourself.
